description: This file defines a configuration state structure and a parser for processing configuration dictionaries related to Voice Talk Mode settings in a Swift project. It includes handling for provider configurations, voice aliases, and default values.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration dictionary to produce a TalkModeGatewayConfigState object, extracting relevant settings such as provider, voice ID, aliases, model ID, output format, API key, and silence timeout.
